name: Shin Kong Life Tower
scope: The Shin Kong Life Tower as photographed in August 2014, including its rose-colored Mitsukoshi podium, continuous office glazing, stepped crown and pyramidal copper-colored roof with mast.

references.filename: Shin Kong Life Tower View from Presidential Building Plaza 20140806.jpg

originalReview.notes: The south-southwest view shows the rose panel grid, alternating teal office bands, setbacks and screens, small crown pyramid and mast. Foreground buildings hide part of the retail base.

review.notes: The exact local Qualla photo matches the photographer’s own CC0 original. The mapped podium perimeter and documented retail floor count fill in the lower area hidden in the photograph.
